$comment: Hình Codex của Bom Nguyên Tố (npm run gen:asset -- bom-nguyen-to/<tên>). Khung hình nhân vật actor-<nguyên tố>-<tư thế> vẽ lại từ chân dung rồi từ tư thế đứng (from); cùng bom, vụ nổ và vật phẩm, chúng ghi ra sources/frames/ và được sources/pack-sprites.py gộp thành atlas.

island.prompt: Original portal thumbnail of floating toy garden3x3 tabletop with mint/honeyyellowtiles, blue daisy stoneblock, peachribbon giftcrate, chubbycreamfaced peachfox and purple smilingbomb withsparkle, mintleafcat peeking atbackcorner. garden.prompt: Wide 16:9 backdrop for a cute garden arena game, seen from above at a gentle angle. The middle 70 percent is a calm, even lawn of soft fresh green grass with faint clover texture and nothing else on it. Decorations only along the borders: leafy green bushes, clover patches, white daisies and pink blossoms along the left and right edges; pastel bunting pennant flags strung across the top-left and top-right corners; puffy pastel pink and white flower bushes in both bottom corners; a pink and yellow pinwheel near the bottom-left; a coral watering can beside a flower pot on the right edge; a short cream stone-slab path entering from the bottom center. Cheerful pastel storybook palette, soft painted shading, gentle warm-brown outlines. No characters, no board, no UI.

logo.prompt: Cute casual mobile game title logo that reads exactly "Bom Nguyên Tố" on two lines. Top line "Bom": big chunky rounded bubbly letters with a warm yellow-to-orange gradient, the letter o drawn as a cute round glossy navy bomb with a lit fuse and a tiny yellow spark. Bottom line "Nguyên Tố": chunky rounded letters with a sky-blue to teal gradient and correct Vietnamese diacritics (the ê has a circumflex, the ố has a circumflex plus an acute accent). Thick dark-brown outline around every letter, a white inner rim, one cream sticker backing behind the whole title, a few small green leaves and white daisies tucked around its edges. Polished cartoon game logo, saturated colors, soft glossy highlights. Single isolated logo on a fully transparent background, centered with generous margin.
